from collections import Counter

def top_k_frequent(nums, k):
    count = Counter(nums)
    return sorted(count, key=count.get, reverse=True)[:k]

def k_closest(points, k):
    return sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1])[:k]
